Roast Beef Salad
By: Anonymous
Published: Saturday, December 19, 2009 - 12:35am

Ingredients




2 cups leftover roast beef, diced
1 lg. tomato, diced
1 med. white onion, diced
1 lg. red apple, diced
1 head lettuce broken in bite-size pieces
Juice of ½ lemon
Mayonnaise

Preparation

1 Mix first 5 ingredients together, squeeze lemon juice over all. Mix with enough mayonnaise to coat. Add salt and pepper to taste. Serve with crackers.
